name: Bass Hold
description: Holds a bass DI in place, note to note.

name: Bright Limit
description: The limit setting with the HF emphasis up: loud passages held down, sibilants first.

name: Drum Bus Squeeze
description: Pulls a drum bus together; the room comes up between hits.

name: Guitar Even
description: Evens out a strummed acoustic guitar a few dB.

name: Vocal Grip
description: Catches a voice's loud syllables quickly and holds the line even.
